description: ConceptZ Studios is a web and design studio that crafts digital storytelling for brands. This time, for the "Abandoned but Not Forgotten" challenge, we are using our design craft to convey the mysteries of Mars and the story of its hardworking rovers. Though much of this hardware now rests silent on the Red Planet, their tireless contributions paved the way for humanity to come this far—ensuring these robotic pioneers are never forgotten.
summary: A story told in seven slides about three machines NASA left behind — and never stopped working. A mirror left on the Moon in 1969 still measures how fast the Moon is drifting away. A Mars rover built for 90 days worked for almost 15 years and proved ancient Mars once had liquid water. Voyager 1, launched in 1977, is now 15 billion miles from home and still sending data, carrying a golden record of Earth. The story is written for school-age space fans: no jargon, every fact from NASA, and one honest correction — the famous line "My battery is low and it's getting dark" is a journalist's retelling of Opportunity's last data, not the rover's own words.
details: A seven-slide story about three machines NASA left behind — and never stopped working. The slides tell how a mirror left on the Moon in 1969 still measures how fast the Moon is drifting away; how a Mars rover built for 90 days worked for almost 15 years and proved ancient Mars once had liquid water; and how Voyager 1, launched in 1977, is now 15 billion miles from home and still sending data, carrying a golden record of Earth. The story is written for school-age space fans, with no jargon, every fact from NASA, and one honest correction: the famous line "My battery is low and it's getting dark" is a journalist's retelling of Opportunity's last data, not the rover's own words. The project is the seven-slide presentation itself; there is no video. All facts are from the NASA sources listed under NASA Data above. No third-party copyrighted material is used. No AI-generated images.
